reason: apply thermo-nuclear review polish on D-0014: document the body-mention heuristic and its word-boundary/namespaced-key assumption, and pin the ambiguity backstop with a test

quality.summary: Applied the thermo-nuclear review's D-0014 polish: no behaviour change, only an expanded comment on the body-match regex (documenting that body-mention is a best-effort signal backstopped by the 2+-match ambiguity skip, and that the trailing \b assumes namespaced keys) plus one additive test pinning that a story mentioned by two PRs (implementer + revert) collapses to ambiguous and links neither. The test asserts counts and that no pr-linked event is emitted. Accurate, minimal, matches the existing backfill test style.

performance.summary: Comment-only change plus one additive unit test. No runtime or hot-path impact whatsoever.

security.summary: Safety-positive documentation change: it makes the D-0014 body-match's honesty limits explicit (a non-owning mention could mislink; the ambiguity skip is the backstop) and adds a test proving the backstop holds, so a non-owning PR mention cannot silently become a story's shipping provenance. No code path, trust boundary, or data flow changes.
